task: Make CLI SSO re-authentication fail fast with a clear error instead of hanging or crashing (ERR_USE_AFTER_CLOSE) when no TTY is available in non-interactive environments.

key_reasoning.reason: The fix must land at or before handleAuthValidationFailure (src/providers/core/auth-validation.ts), the single shared gate reached by three independent call sites (AgentCLI.handleRun, cli/commands/profile/index.ts, utils/auth.ts:getAuthenticatedClient) and by the ProviderSetupSteps contract shared by every current and future provider plugin — a fix scoped to only one caller would leave the others vulnerable.

Touches the SSO authentication/re-authentication flow (auth red flag), though risk is tempered by strong in-repo precedent: JWT's provider already omits promptForReauth and fails cleanly, and process.stdin.isTTY detection already exists (for a different UI style) — no proof-of-concept or novel architecture needed.

Acceptance criteria are well-specified (detect non-interactive, clean non-zero exit, actionable message, no readline crash, regression tests), but one open design decision remains: where exactly to centralize the TTY/non-interactive check so all three call sites and all ProviderSetupSteps implementers benefit, and whether a new --non-interactive flag is required or TTY auto-detection alone suffices.

red_flags_applied: Component Scope bumped from M to L: touches core shared utilities — auth-validation.ts's handleAuthValidationFailure is a shared choke point for 3 call sites and the ProviderSetupSteps contract implemented by every provider.
Technical Risk bumped from S to M: affects authentication/authorization — the change is in the SSO re-authentication flow.
